pages.title: Batteries
pages.text: Because different mods implement batteries in different ways, AeroIE cannot simply bind to any block that contains FE. Its dedicated batteries can be charged by any FE cable, but only a Control Seat can extract their energy. The seat distributes that energy among all linked systems. Larger components generally consume more power, and every Control Seat system stops working when the vessel runs out of energy.
The three battery capacities are:$(br2)Small: 100 kFE$(br2)Medium: 1 MFE$(br2)Large: 10 MFE
